glossary.definition: (A) "Food processor" means any person, other than an egg breaker, who utilizes broken eggs to produce a food product.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.01 to 925.13 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.01 - Production, processing, maintenance and sale of shell eggs definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Processor" means any person engaged in the operation of assembling, receiving, grading, or packing shell eggs for commercial sale or distribution.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.01 to 925.13 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.01 - Production, processing, maintenance and sale of shell eggs definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Producer" means any person engaged in the operation of egg production who maintains annually more than five hundred birds.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.01 to 925.13 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.01 - Production, processing, maintenance and sale of shell eggs definitions.
